name: LiveAreaDesigner
description: A PS Vita homebrew editor for prototyping LiveArea cards and buttons in pixel coordinates
long_description: LiveArea Designer helps homebrew authors prototype the images and layout of a PS Vita LiveArea page. The simulator has a **960 × 544** screen and a **840 × 500** card whose top 44 pixels are reserved for system controls. The editable **frame image/button** stays out of that area.
